neighbours.label: the end of a conditional or 'when/where' clause (its last word or comma) just before a main clause that qualifies it ('if X is used, it must ...'; 'when Y were taken, they were ...')
fire: The guidelines are clear on this point. If a ladder is used, it should be tied off at the top.
She is a patient teacher. If she raises her voice, it is only for a good reason.
The archive is poorly kept. Where records survive, they are often incomplete and hard to read.
Funding was scarce that decade. When repairs were made, they were usually done by volunteers.
The disease is hard to spot early. If symptoms appear, they tend to be mild at first.
The policy is rarely enforced. When fines are issued, they are usually small.
The software is old but stable. If a crash occurs, it is almost always a hardware fault.
The tribe kept few written laws. Where disputes arose, they were settled by the elders.
